reason: The official data.gov.uk catalogue exposes a Source Metadata XML resource for HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons, but the current transport cannot follow the redirect to the CKAN harvest-object XML endpoint. This is a materially different metadata-access method from the prior GML download, transaction-to-INSPIRE CSV lookup, and WMS GetCapabilities attempts, yet it still cannot yield a concrete parcel feature or identifier here. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
